wiki_text: On 2026-04-30, TES (Tree Energy Solutions) launched 'Jade Energy' as the new dedicated brand/platform for its Wilhelmshaven import-terminal and green-energy-hub project (Voslapper Groden Nord site, ~145 ha, Germany's only deep-water port). The LNG/e-NG import terminal remains the first component to be delivered, alongside a planned CO2 export terminal and future hydrogen units, integrated with the OGE pipeline connection that already serves the existing Wilhelmshaven TES FSRU. Fortescue is named as a partner on the jadeenergy.de site (per a 2022 TES-Fortescue agreement covering a EUR30M equity stake in TES, a EUR100M construction-funding commitment, and a green-hydrogen/e-methane offtake arrangement) -- the exact equity relationship to this specific terminal asset is not clearly documented, so it was not staged as Owner/Parent. Some secondary AI-search summaries cited a 2030 commercial-operations date and 15-20+ bcm/y capacity, but these figures could not be confirmed on the primary jadeenergy.de/tes-h2.com pages directly fetched and checked -- treat as unconfirmed pending a firmer primary or trade-press source.
